intro: Kyrgyzstan is a mountain country whose nomadic people kept their traditions through empires and the Soviet era.

chapters.title: Silk Road mountains
text: Silk Road caravans crossed the Tian Shan through Kyrgyzstan. Tash Rabat is a stone caravanserai high in the mountains, and the Burana Tower is a minaret from an old city called Balasagun.
The Kyrgyz people's legends are told in the Manas epic, one of the longest poems in the world.

chapters.title: Russia and the Soviets
text: Russia took over in the 1870s. In 1916 a revolt against Russian rule was crushed, and many Kyrgyz fled to China. In Soviet times nomads were forced onto collective farms.

chapters.title: Independence and revolutions
text: Kyrgyzstan became independent in 1991. Protests overthrew presidents in 2005, 2010 and 2020. In 2010 violence between Kyrgyz and Uzbeks in the south killed hundreds.
